The structure of composition Ga16P4F8 (reduced formula Ga4PF2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group P2₁/c (No. 15), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Ga and P centers, each surrounded by six geometric neighbors, while F centers show four Ga neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals edge-sharing between Ga octahedra and between F four-vertex polyhedra.
